item.title: We studied 1,584 data centers—and found the buildings full of machines are tied to modest local job growth
item.description: Data centers require enormous investments: land, buildings, computer equipment and power infrastructure. Yet, once they're up and running, they tend to employ no more than a few dozen people in occupations such as IT technicians, engineers and security guards. With billions of dollars flowing into new data centers across the United States, communities are asking what they will get in return. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Extreme risk protection orders are designed to prevent gun violence. But how do they impact the people subject to them?
item.description: About 125 people die from gun violence through homicide or suicide in the United States every day. Many more are injured by firearms. Extreme risk protection orders (ERPOs), known in California as gun violence restraining orders, are designed to keep firearms temporarily away from people at risk of harming themselves or others. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: A 219-acre Florida cattle ranch facing development pressure was approved for a $20.15 million conservation easement in September 2026, allowing agriculture to continue while permanently restricting development
item.description: A 219-acre cattle ranch in Florida received protection through a $20.15 million conservation agreement. This easement is part of a broader initiative preserving over 4,500 acres of agricultural land. The agreement ensures that the ranch can remain operational while preventing future development. It reflects efforts to balance agricultural needs with urban expansion pressures in the state. Protecting this land is vital for maintaining both wildlife habitats and agricultural sustainability. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: 98 reacciones · 12 comentarios | EUA - O Departamento de Estado dos EUA concederá vistos a Flávio Bolsonaro e a sua família e permitirá a entrada deles no país, segundo informou uma autoridade do órgão à repórter da TV Globo Raquel Krähenbühl. O governo Trump não informou se o senador já está no território americano. ➡️Mais cedo, a agência de notícias Reuters e o jornal "The New York Times" informaram, citando fontes anônimas, que o senador deixou o Brasil rumo aos Estados Unidos. O caso é investigado pela Polícia Federal (PF). Antes, um jornal argentino divulgou que o senador teria saído do Brasil pela fronteira com Puerto Iguazú, na Argentina. Segundo a reportagem do Infobae, Flávio teria cruzado a fronteira para a Argentina usando seu documento de identidade. "De Puerto Iguazú, viajaria aos Estados Unidos a bordo de um avião Gulfstream G400, de matrícula LV-JQW, pertencente à empresa Baires Fly S.A", informa o site. Segundo o site de monitoramento aéreo FlightRadar24, a aeronave voou de Buenos Aires para Puerto Iguazú e chegou à cidade às 23h45, no horário de Brasília. O avião, no entanto, não havia deixado a cidade desde então, segundo os registros. Não há confirmação até o momento se Flávio chegou a estar na aeronave e se teria trocado de avião para seguir para os Estados Unidos. Veja os detalhes no #g1 #fláviobolsonaro #eua #governotrump | g1 - O Portal de Notícias da globo
